expansion_tokens.description: most tokens one expansion may produce

facts.description: most definitions, uses and other facts recorded

file_depth.x-example: a file that inputs itself stops after 64 levels

format_steps.description: the same for reading the LaTeX format, which is cached after the first time

heads_apart.description: how many versions of one loop satex keeps apart while they still differ in what they will run

held_tokens.description: most tokens waiting to be read at once

interval_set.description: how many ranges a number keeps before they are merged into one

join_arms.description: how many merged branches remember which values belong together. 0 remembers none

line_steps.description: how long one source line may run before what it does is approximated and reading goes on. 0 = no limit

loop_entries.description: how often calls at one place may enter a loop afresh before it is summarized

loop_heads.description: how many loops one run remembers. The oldest is forgotten first

may_run_depth.description: how many macro levels deep satex follows code a join made unknown to find what it may assign

meaning_set.description: how many possible meanings a name keeps after branches merge before it becomes unknown

meaning_splits.description: how often one command may split a run per meaning of a name that has several

memory.description: most memory one run may use. It stops cleanly beyond it. 0 lifts the limit

paths.description: how many alternative paths satex keeps at once before merging the oldest two. Higher is more precise and slower

probe_steps.description: tokens one trial run may read when a hover learns what a command does. Eight runs answer one question

recursion_depth.description: how deep an undecided recursion is followed before it is assumed to end

repeat_failures.description: how often satex may meet the same thing it cannot follow at one place before skipping that expansion

replay_steps.description: how long satex may rerun a line the document wrote to a file, to learn the labels in it

save_stack.description: most assignments one group may have to undo, about 200 MB

seconds.description: most seconds one run may take, a safety net. 0 for no limit

site_expansions.description: how often one place may expand without reading further before it is given up

site_forks.description: how many paths one place in a line may start before its \if is approximated. 0 = never

steps.description: how many tokens the document may run through before the run stops. Raise it for huge documents

trace.x-example: a trace of a long run shows only its start

trace_state.description: most entries each list of a dev-mode step state holds (bindings, stacks, catcodes)

value_set.description: how many exact values a number or length keeps after branches merge before only its range is kept

trace.x-example: on: `satex trace` can step through the run

trace_state.description: dev mode: each trace step carries the abstract state it ran in (paths, stacks, bindings)
trace_state.x-example: on: `satex trace --state --format json` shows why two paths stay apart

type_plugins.description: editor features by type, grouped by category: widget, hover, completion, lint, incremental (satex query type-plugins)

bibliography.description: citation keys and the .bib entries the run read

enabled.description: a manager: search by key, author, title, year, edit fields, add per entry type, delete unused
swatches, picker dialog, model conversions and color completion
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no color items, swatches or picker

name.description: what a color the picker defines is called, numbered when taken

swatches.description: a swatch next to each color a color command uses

comment_edit.description: an edit inside a comment every read of its line skipped, no %\satex@ directive or magic comment

enabled.description: keep the last run instead of analyzing again, the rules still read the new text
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: typing in a comment runs the document again

enabled.description: "Change environment…": switch one occurrence, both ends and its arguments

float.description: floats: environments whose code reaches \@float (figure, table and the ones defined on them)

enabled.description: what each placement letter lets LaTeX do, their completion, a dialog of toggles
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no placement hover, completion or dialog

forest.description: a forest environment the run met, a blank line of the document body

enabled.description: "Edit tree…": add, delete, rename and drag nodes, node and `for tree` options, indented outlines in
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no tree lens, action or dialog

frame.description: a beamer frame the run met

enabled.description: "Compile only this frame": \includeonlyframes with the frame's label, one added when it has none

glossary.description: declared keys: glossary entries, acronyms, abbreviations

enabled.description: a manager: search, edit fields, add like the document's own, delete or replace uses
a code lens and hover link to the crop, rotate and size dialog, rotate and fit actions
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no image lens, dialog or actions

enabled.description: a manager: terms with subentries in sorted order, rename a term everywhere

keys.description: key lists: pgfkeys, l3keys, kvoptions and package options

enabled.description: completion and hover docs in key lists
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no key items or key hovers

family_continue.description: accepting a family (`/demo`) inserts `/demo/` and opens its keys

overlay.description: an overlay specification, text a command reads between < and > (beamer's \only<2->)

enabled.description: the slides of the frame the material shows on, completion of the frame's steps

savebox.description: a \begin name of a picture, listing or other environment the run met

enabled.description: "Store in a box": move it to the preamble as a saved box, refused where it reads its position

table.description: tables: environments whose code reaches \@array (tabular, tabular*, tabularx, array)

enabled.description: a code lens and hover link to the grid dialog, booktabs and siunitx rewrites
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no table lens, dialog or rewrites

enabled.description: a manager: kinds with counters and styles, instances with labels and references, rename, numbering

tikz.description: a tikzpicture the run met, a blank line of the document body

enabled.description: "Edit drawing…": nodes and arrows on a canvas, Mermaid import and export
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no drawing lens, action or dialog

grid.description: the grid in cm a dragged or added node snaps to

spacing.description: the distance in cm between the ranks of an imported Mermaid flowchart

typing.description: letters typed into a control word the run met undefined

enabled.description: the last results stand, marked provisional, until typing pauses
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: each pause of the debounce runs the document again

pause_ms.description: how long typing pauses before the run follows
pause_ms.x-example: `3000`: a name typed slowly is run once

decimals.description: decimals a converted length is written with

enabled.description: hover in every unit (each value writes itself) and a converter dialog
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: no conversions on a length

units.description: the units a hover shows and the conversions offered

whitespace_edit.description: spaces added where every read skipped one, white space past the last line read

enabled.description: keep the last run, its results moved along the line
enabled.x-example: `enabled: false`: indenting a line runs the document again
